messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the on‑prem packaging onboarding runbook. Looking at VPC/onprem launch lanes and customer-managed networking asks. TL;DR: suggest 3 launch lanes (self-managed network, simple peering, cloud-edge proxy). Need clear MVP features + gating metrics. I pasted customer asks from Acme & BetaCorp below. Please call out must-haves vs nice-to-haves by EOD.

mike: quick Q — do we have a concrete upgrade path for customers on older installers? in-place patch vs full re-install matters for field ops.

sam: Acme wants IP preservation and deterministic outbound IPs. BetaCorp wants KMS + audit logs and the ability to bring their own peering. both flagged HA control plane as blocker.

ana (typo fix): oh nm, meant ana below :)

ana: ana: security notes — must include KMS/HSM integration for Private, immutability of audit logs for compliance customers, and network egress allowlist rules by default. also require an approval flow for exposing admin ports.

nick: From field: rollback window is huge. Customers expect <15m rolling revert for config-only upgrades. Any plan that needs >2h downtime will get pushback.

jess: propose canary rollout + verify metrics: 1) inference latency SLO across 95th, 2) token cost delta < 10%, 3) DNS/peering attach success rate > 99%. if canary fails auto-fallback to hosted routing. :thumbsup:

mike: installer constraints: support k8s 1.21-1.25 for MVP, prefer helm chart + sealed-secrets workflow. upgrade options:
```
- patch: helm upgrade w/ rolling restart for runtime pods
- upgrade-major: operator-run plan that migrates KV cache between nodes
```

sam: prioritization suggestion: Score each ask on (security risk, uptime impact, field demand, implementation effort). Example: IP preservation = high field demand, medium effort; KMS = high security risk, low-medium effort.

ana: also flag network telemetry — we need flow logs (s3/gs) + per-tenant connection audit for compliance. That affects storage sizing and egress costs; include in cost estimate.

dev-deploy-bot: :information_source: New doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onprem/onboard-runbook-draft (internal)

elaine: Narrowing scope suggestion from PM: MVP lane = simple peering (+ deterministic egress via NAT), minimal KMS support (KMS only, no HSM), upgrade path = in-place helm patch + operator-assisted major. Gate criteria:
- successful canary on 3 pilot customers
- <15m rollback verified in test harness
- audit logs retained 90d and immutable

jess: if we accept that lane we should schedule a field pilot with Acme and one small beta. Acme can do peering in their VPC this sprint.

nick: I can coordinate the pilot dates. Need an inventory of IP ranges + expected throughput from acme — can someone ask SEs to collect? @sam pls?

sam: on it. I'll open a short checklist template for IP + throughput + account contacts.

mike: engineering asks: give us a short list of exact supported topologies (peer, nat, proxy) and we'll produce a mapping of required infra changes + estimated story points by Thurs.

elaine: action items:
- sam: gather pilot customer network inventories (due Tue)
- mike: engineering topology effort estimate (due Thurs)
- ana: final KMS + audit retention spec (due Wed)
- jess/nick: pilot scheduling & rollback test plan (due next Mon)
- me (elaine): update runbook draft w/ the MVP lane and gating criteria, add canary steps and acceptance checklist.

elaine: Final ask — if you have any hard-block must-haves (regulatory or contractual) shout now. Otherwise we'll move to firm scope and get eng estimates. Thanks! :pray:
